about_the_game:
Descend into the underbelly of the megalopolis and reclaim control of the Black Maw, a tavern where every service can turn into a nightmare. Receive loot, trade, fish, manage supplies, and clean up. But be careful: between a bad meal and too much liquor, tempers can flare fast. One angry guest, a broken alliance, or a regulator inspection, and chaos erupts. In the turmoil, your establishment becomes a real battlefield. Protect the sanctuary entrusted to you and make it thrive here, a failed service is always paid in blood and violence.

Experiment with corrupted and forbidden ingredients. Brew cursed dishes with occult flavors to soothe, manipulate, or corrupt your patrons. A single wrong dose or botched service can spark rumors, panic, and chaos drawing the merciless gaze of the regulators.

Lead a team of misfits and maintain service quality. Make poachers, gangs, and spies coexist under the same roof. Keep your clientele in line with an iron fist to avoid tantrums and intimidation. And if things get out of hand? Your demonic hound takes care of the leftovers.

Brawls, missing guests, suspicious cooking, cursed ingredients, forbidden spells everything eventually leaks. Beware of spies, avoid denunciations, and forge alliances to cover your tracks. Stay tuned to the Radio Furnace for rumors and city trends. One misstep, and the regulators will come knocking.

Maintain your clandestine herbarium and harvest ingredients to craft potions, cocktails, and dishes. Plant, garden, and gather delightfully corrupted fruits and vegetables. Go fishing, raise strange creatures, and exploit their resources.

Barter, buy, and sell: manage your finances legally or through the black market. Invest in upgrades and occult supplies from shady merchants. Decorate the tavern, optimize your resources, make it flourish and much more.

Your tavern is a sanctuary. Make the cult you inherited prosper: recruit members, pay their bounties, and reclaim their loot. Perform rituals and grow the influence of the Order of the Echomancers.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features frequent stylized gore in a dark-fantasy setting. Visuals are non-realistic / cartoon-like. Scenes include the butchering and cooking of fantasy creatures (e.g., fairies, demons, dragons), blood, dismemberment, and corpse handling, presented with dark comedy. There can be tavern brawls and occasional strong language. The tavern depicts alcohol and tobacco use.
There is no explicit sexual content, no sexual violence, no depiction of minors, and no real-world extremist symbols or hate speech.
